title: Which capsule should I use => More AI heavy, or ingame models?
author: AC-Daniel
selftext:
Hey there,

had a post recently about getting torn apart due to using some AI. Now i wonder if it might be due to the capsule art. My question is => which one would you prefer? the original one or the one with the in game characters? In the end i came to realize, i shouldnt care too much about people flaming me for using AI => So which one would you say has more potential? I guess for the potential new one, i would clean up the different environment layers further. But this would be the basic idea.

Potential new one? old one can be seen in my store [https://partner.steamgames.com/apps/landing/5282860](https://partner.steamgames.com/apps/landing/5282860)

comments.author: Valdaraak
comments.body: Here's the thing. The people shitting on you for AI capsule art are going to shit on you for *any* AI used. And since your new one really doesn't look much different than the current one (same style, same character, same lighting), changing the art isn't likely to stop the complaints.

comments.author: hammackj
comments.body: I’d learn more towards the game style. Less chance of someone skipping the click due to “ai slop” and judging a book by the cover. Hope that helps

replies.author: AC-Daniel
replies.body: aight thank you that is what i thought + it gives a better impression what the game is about i guess - old one though looks much cooler

comments.author: cxfoulke
comments.body: Honestly I think the game needs more time in the oven.   But capsule art is the most important part it's worth spending money on. Or alot of personal effort.

replies.author: AC-Daniel
replies.body: I dont plan on releasing it any time soon tbh - (maybe around Q2 2027) - so still much time for improvements

comments.author: Square-Yam-3772
comments.body:
the old one looks better as a small capsule I think

both versions look AI so you may need a third version if you try to want to avoid "AI made" impression

personally I don't think it matters due to AI disclosure (I also had people checking my reddit post history to find out that I frequently post here and then deduced that I use AI, which is funny because I do disclose AI use...)
